notes: Grow Up David is part of the David Shannon series. The story follows David being told to grow up by his older brother, exploring themes of sibling rivalry, emotions, and childhood behaviour. Core vocabulary around size (big/little), emotions (mad, cry), and social actions (share, play) are highly relevant. The hero image must match David Shannon's distinctive illustration style — the generic Boardmaker boy symbol will not be recognisable to students familiar with the book. Consider adding a sibling or family symbol if board space allows in future iterations.
